description: Record a quality inspection of a started work order's output on an account with work order QA turned on. Append the units an inspector measured (each unit's measures in measurement plan order: value for a dimension, passed for a go/no-go gauge), set or replace the line's measurementPlan, and finish=true when inspection is done. Each unit is classified ok, rework (above tolerance, failed gauge, or missing measure) or scrap (below tolerance), as the work-order QA screen does; only ok units are received when the work order completes (execute_manufacturing_step complete_work with the ok count). Preview first; the preview shows each new unit's result and the totals. Requires Write + manufacturing.execute on an unpinned operator credential. In-app assistants get a confirm card the user applies.

finish.description: True when inspection of this line is done; the work order can then be completed with the accepted units.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

measurementPlan.description: The line's measurement plan (up to 30 rows). Required when the line has none yet; giving one replaces the saved plan and re-classifies units already recorded.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

units.description: Units inspected, appended after the units already recorded (up to 100 per call). Each unit lists one measure per measurement plan row, in plan order.

workOrderItemId.description: Output line id (GUID) from get_work_order's items (isFinalProduct=true). Omit when the work order has one output line.

name: record_work_order_qa
title: Record Work Order QA
